card.name: Linking words before confirmatory testing
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right after a diagnosis, suspicion or test result, where a confirming test or exam is about to be named. Examples are 'confirmed by', 'such as', 'diagnosis with' and the full stop after 'medical history'.

modes.label: Confirm by/with
modes.description: A preposition after confirmed, excluded, corroborated or diagnosis, leading into a diagnostic method.
modes.example: should be suspended until PML has been excluded<< by>> an appropriate diagnostic evaluation.

modes.label: Confirmatory tests such as
modes.description: The word 'as' in 'Confirmatory tests, such as' before a named lab method.
modes.example: Confirmatory tests, such<< as>> gas chromatography/mass spectrometry

modes.label: History then exam
modes.description: Full stop after 'symptoms and medical history' just before the physical exam sentence.
modes.example: Your doctor will ask about your symptoms and medical history<<.>> A physical exam will be done.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about examination, confirmation and conducted or preliminary testing.
card.plain: It fires at the small word just before the text names the test or exam used to confirm a diagnosis.
